claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Alosetron is a 5-HT3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Alosetron is a 5-HT3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
